== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on February 24, 2024.
** The 46th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on June 05, 2025.
** The 29th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on June 06, 2026.
** The 21th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on July 26, 2025.
** Was the 39th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on May 30, 2026.
** Was the 28th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL.

===Individual Awards===
* LPL 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Split 2 2026)
* LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Split 1 2026)
* LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Split 2 2025)
* LPL Jungler of the Year (2024)
